scope: Guarded app-only installation, flash device-checksum verification, and serial boot-health evidence for units A and B. Multiplayer runtime and gameplay acceptance are separate and remain pending in this record.
selected_scope:
App-only 0.66 successor for the separately backed-up and checksum-bound Tab5 A/ST7121 and B/ST7123. Preserve the pinned SDK, bootloader, partition table, OTA selector, NVS, settings, SD content and protected game lineage. Retain the existing remote input, immutable framebuffer capture, menu hierarchy and verified arena storage contracts.

Add protocol-7 fresh guest admission to an already-running solo Doom Arena host and returning owned-seat admission using bounded canonical replay, immutable initial roster and nonce-bound runtime traffic. Pace host live/replay traffic through one bounded send budget; coalesce redundant replay progress/ready traffic while preserving activation and live acknowledgements. Increase the Tab5 UDP receive mailbox to 32 with matching generated-config guards. Yield for one tick when replay has no canonical commands ready, without slowing available commands.

Move Tab5 Doom conversion and existing blocking display submission onto a shared core-1 worker with two immutable PSRAM frame leases, bounded queueing, error propagation and joined teardown. Preserve platform ownership of PPA/scanout retirement. Align each verified storage cache to 64 bytes. Replace the normal-play opaque score rectangle with a compact explicit SCORE/CLOSE label while retaining its touch target, controller toggle and full-frame score/break restoration. Preserve the previously corrected music parser and add bounded music control admission independent of the SFX queue.

Bind exact final runtime/build/test inputs and retain preimages and host test receipts. Separate previously installed native Tide Maze 0.2.2 and Yahtzee 1.4.2 package fixes from this firmware-only artifact. Hardware acceptance requires both host directions, a first late guest, repeated guest departure/rejoin while host progress continues without another Start, score/break close restoration, correlated music/SFX activity and actual speaker confirmation, and active cadence of at least 25 FPS per the latest user request. Continue aiming for at least 30 FPS, the repository release floor. Native multiplayer acceptance follows through the verified nine-game inventory once Doom meets its hardware gates. Compilation, flashing, sparse counters and screenshots alone do not establish full physical gameplay or acoustic acceptance.
